parole.significato: Suffix appended to words to create a feminine noun, usually an abstract noun denoting a quality.

parole.significato: this, last (found in a few, mostly obsolete or dialectal, terms referring to time)
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *sь (“this”). Doublet of цей (cej), a borrowing from Old Church Slavonic. Cognates Belarusian and Russian -сь (-sʹ). See also сей (sej), the inherited independent form.

parole.significato: -ia, a suffix used in place names.
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *-ьskъ.

parole.significato: Used to form adjectives, often from nouns; -ish, -y, of -'s (double genitive).

parole.significato: Reflexive suffix appended to finite verbs and infinitives to make a reflexive, reciprocal, intransitive or passive verb.

parole.significato: The infinitive ending of verbs in Ukrainian.

parole.significato: Deverbal from perfective mono-syllabic simple stems, forms passive participles

For the participle use, compare Proto-Germanic *-þaz and Latin -tus. However the verb classes that take *-þaz in Proto-Germanic (so-called “weak verbs”) take *-nъ (“-ний”)
Inherited from Proto-Slavic *-ьskъ, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *-iškas, from Proto-Indo-European *-iskos.

parole.significato: Suffix appended to words to create a feminine noun, usually a diminutive form expressing endearment.

parole.significato: forms nouns denoting objects or (usually) abstract concepts from verbs, or occasionally from adjectives

parole.significato: Noun-forming diminutive suffix used after a soft (palatalized) consonant.
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *-ja. Cognate Russian -я (-ja).

parole.significato: Suffix added to adjectives to form intransitive verbs that describe having or gaining the property of said adjective.

parole.significato: to speak, to tell (also used in folklore)

From Proto-Slavic *bez, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *beź, from Proto-Indo-European *bʰeǵʰs, from Proto-Indo-European *bʰe (instrumental particle) + Proto-Indo-European *-ǵʰs (“out”).

parole.significato: wool (hair of sheep and some other ruminants)
